# CompressorSoundEffect

- Inherits [`SoundEffect`](soundeffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("CompressorSoundEffect")`

Reduces the loud parts of a sound so that the whole can be made louder. Use it to keep speech audible over music, or to stop an explosion from drowning out everything else.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Attack` | `number` | `0.01` | read/write | How quickly the compressor reacts to a loud part, in seconds. |
| `MakeupGain` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The gain added to the whole sound after compression, in decibels, from 0 to 24. |
| `Ratio` | `number` | `4` | read/write | How much the sound above the threshold is reduced. At 4, a sound four decibels over the threshold comes out one decibel over. |
| `Release` | `number` | `0.1` | read/write | How quickly the compressor stops reducing after a loud part, in seconds. |
| `Threshold` | `number` | `-20` | read/write | The level above which the sound is reduced, in decibels, from -60 to 0. |
